'''Hanna Dodiuk-Kening''' ([[Hebrew language|Hebrew]]: חנה דודיוק-קניג; born June 20, 1948) is an [[Israel]]<nowiki/>i [[chemist]] and an inventor. Her fields of expertise are [[adhesive]] technology, [[polymer]]s and development of [[Nanotechnology|nano-technology]].

== Biography ==
Dodiuk was born in 1948 in [[Kraków]], [[Poland]].<ref>{{cite web |title=27 פטנטים, קריירה ביטחונית ואישה אחת|url=https://www.motke.co.il/27-%D7%A4%D7%98%D7%A0%D7%98%D7%99%D7%9D,-%D7%A7%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%94-%D7%91%D7%99%D7%98%D7%97%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%AA-%D7%95%D7%90%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%94-%D7%90%D7%97%D7%AA|website=motke.co.il|language=he|access-date=2023-05-21}}</ref> Her parents were [[holocaust survivors]], rescued from the [[Auschwitz concentration camp]] as they were part of the ''[[schindlerjuden]]''.

She received her [[Bachelor of Science|B.Sc]] degree in the field of chemistry in 1970 from [[Tel Aviv University]], and finished her [[Master of Science|M.Sc]] with honors in 1973. After completing her [[Doctor of Philosophy|PHD]] under the supervision of [[Edward Kosower]], she became a member of the chemistry faculty in Tel Aviv University and a [[lecturer]] for 2 years.

Dodiuk began working in 1979 at [[Rafael Advanced Defense Systems]], where she worked for 18 years. She began her career there as an adhesion engineer and held various R&D positions. In 1991 she was appointed director of the Materials and Processes Department.<ref name=":0">{{Cite book |last=Dodiuk |first=Hanna |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=C2GLuQAACAAJ |title=Handbook of Thermoset Plastics |date=2013-11-28 |publisher=Elsevier Science |isbn=978-1-4557-3107-7}}</ref> - making her the first female senior manager at Rafael.

After her retirement from Rafael, Dodiuk held the position of the President of the Israeli Polymer & Plastics Society (IPPS) for 2 years, and was the first elected woman of the organization. In 2013 she became the first woman to become an honorary fellow from the IPPS.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Shenkar - Prof. Hanna Dodiuk achieved Honorary Fellow of the Israel Polymers and Plastics Society |url=https://www.shenkar.ac.il/en/news_items/IPPS-honorable-membership-dodiuk |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=shenkar.ac.il}}</ref>

Dodiuk began her academic career at the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology|Technion]]. In 1996 on joined [[Shenkar College of Engineering, Design and Art|Shenkar College]] and in 2000 became a full professor at the institute.

She was appointed head of the Department of Plastic Engineering at Shenkar in 2006, and since 2020 she has been acting as the head of Polymer Materials Engineering M.Sc Program.

In addition, she has held a number of short-term roles: as a visiting scientist for [[Bayer|The Bayer Company]]; and as a visiting professor at the [[New Jersey Institute of Technology]] and at the [[University of Massachusetts Lowell]].<ref name=":0" />

In 2017, Dodiuk became a member of the [[Council for Higher Education in Israel]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=עדכון הרכבי הוועדות העליונות למינוי פרופסורים |url=https://che.org.il/decision/%d7%a2%d7%93%d7%9b%d7%95%d7%9f-%d7%94%d7%a8%d7%9b%d7%91%d7%99-%d7%94%d7%95%d7%95%d7%a2%d7%93%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%94%d7%a2%d7%9c%d7%99%d7%95%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%aa-%d7%9c%d7%9e%d7%99%d7%a0%d7%95%d7%99-%d7%a4/ |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=המועצ |language=he-IL}}</ref>

==Books and articles==
Dodiuk has contributed to the publications of several books in the fields of plastics and polymers, and was the editor of two books: ''Handbook of Thermoset Plastics'' and ''Recent Advances in Adhesion Science and Technology''.

In addition, she is the author and the co-author for more than 200 scientific publications. She is also a member of ''Polymers'', the international [[Open access|open-access]] journal of polymer science published by [[MDPI]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=MDPI - Publisher of Open Access Journals |url=https://www.mdpi.com/search?authors=hanna+dodiuk&journal=polymers |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=mdpi.com}}</ref>

==Patents==
Dodiuk is responsible for the development and registration of over 20 patents.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hanna Dodiuk-Kenig Inventions, Patents and Patent Applications - Justia Patents Search |url=https://patents.justia.com/inventor/hanna-dodiuk-kenig |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=patents.justia.com}}</ref> Some of her notable patents:
* A dental material using [[nanofiber]] reinforcement to create minimal sacrifice and bleeding, (application).<ref>{{Cite patent|country=US|number=2007043142|status=application|pubdate=2007-02-22|title=Dental compositions based on nanofiber reinforcement|inventor1-last=Dodiuk-Kenig|inventor1-first=Hanna|inventor2-last=Zalsman|inventor2-first=Barry|inventor3-last=Lisenboim|inventor3-first=Kira|inventor4-last=Mchale|inventor4-first=William A.}}, since abandoned.</ref>
* A new non-adhesive coating that can repel water and ice.<ref>{{Cite web |title=UMass Lowell and Shenkar College Join Forces to Develop Smart, Self-cleaning Coatings|publisher=UMass Lowell|url=https://www.uml.edu/engineering/research/engineering-solutions/shenkar-coatings.aspx |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=uml.edu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-12-17 |title=UML, Israel School Work on Revolutionary Patents |url=https://apnews.com/article/----5f9b592da5c646de9b016f71fee6518c |access-date=2023-05-17 |work=AP NEWS}}</ref>  The patent was presented at the exhibition "Israeli Discoveries and Developments that Influenced the World" held at [[Ben Gurion Airport]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Shenkar - Ice-repellent surfaces developed at Sehnkar stood out at the Israeli influential discoveries exhibition |url=https://www.shenkar.ac.il/en/news_items/lotus-effect-inventions-airpot |access-date=2023-05-17 |website=shenkar.ac.il |archive-date=2023-05-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230517101402/https://www.shenkar.ac.il/en/news_items/lotus-effect-inventions-airpot |url-status=dead }}</ref>
